title: Futuristic Cyber Audio Visualizer
overview: A web-based application that provides a high-fidelity, cyberpunk-themed visual representation of audio input. The application will process real-time audio data using the Web Audio API and map it to dynamic, neon-styled visual elements using Canvas or WebGL, specifically hosted at apps/audio-visualizer/index.html.

userStories.want: to see real-time visual representations of music
userStories.soThat: they can experience an immersive, futuristic visual experience while listening to tracks.

userStories.want: to upload an audio file and generate a visualizer
userStories.soThat: they can create visually engaging content for social media or personal use.

functionalRequirements: Support for real-time microphone input via Web Audio API.
Support for local audio file uploads (mp3, wav, ogg).
Real-time Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) analysis to extract frequency and amplitude data.
Dynamic visual rendering featuring neon aesthetics, glitch effects, and 3D-like geometry.
User interface controls to adjust visual intensity, color palettes, and sensitivity.
Responsive layout to ensure functionality across desktop and mobile browsers.
nonFunctionalRequirements: High performance: Maintain a consistent 60 FPS for smooth visual transitions.
Low latency: Ensure visual updates are synchronized with the audio output.
Cross-browser compatibility: Support for Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.
Accessibility: High contrast UI elements for better visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: The application successfully captures and processes audio from both a microphone and a file upload.
Visual elements react dynamically and accurately to changes in audio frequency.
The UI matches the 'cyber' aesthetic (dark mode, neon accents, high-tech styling).
The application is accessible and functional at the specified path: apps/audio-visualizer/index.html.
